method.modelBody: Each local weekday-hour is a Poisson event cell with a Gamma prior (α {{alpha}}, β {{beta}}). Outputs are modeled likelihood estimates, not calibrated probabilities.
method.windowBody: The model filters the newest rows returned by /drives to an absolute {{days}}-day lookback. A {{limit}}-row response can be capped and is not guaranteed lifetime history.
method.timezoneBody: Bucketing, weekday support, DST boundaries, half-hour offsets, and upcoming slots use the selected vehicle timezone: {{timeZone}}.
method.eventsBody: Every recorded drive start counts as a departure by design. Multiple trips on one local day are separate events; the model does not infer a unique driver or destination.
method.inputsBody: No calendar, destination, geofence, weather, battery temperature, state of charge, charging plan, traffic, or driver-identity input is used.
method.limitsBody: The 20-minute planning marker is illustrative and appears only with enough descriptive support. It does not schedule climate, wake, charge, navigate, or command the vehicle.
method.title: Methodology and limitations
method.subtitle: What the forecast learns, what it excludes, and how to interpret every estimate.
method.notice: Planning aid only: no automation is created, and no departure is promised.
